# KiloBuilds — full reference

This is the expanded reference file for AI assistants and crawlers. See
https://kilobuilds.com/llms.txt for the condensed version.

## Who

KiloBuilds was founded by David Akilo, an AI Systems Engineer building
production automations for D2C brands and performance agencies, based
remotely in Lagos, Nigeria (UTC+1). Instead of selling 40-page transformation
decks, KiloBuilds sits inside the client's actual stack (Shopify Plus, Meta
Ads, Klaviyo, Next.js, Supabase, n8n), finds the repetitive workflow costing
the team hours every week, and ships a working system the client owns 100%.

## Services

### Multi-Store Catalog & Translation Pipelines
https://kilobuilds.com/services/multi-store-catalog-translation/
Keep product copy, variants, metafields, and pricing synchronized across
regional Shopify Plus storefronts with AI-assisted translation and mandatory
human approval queues.

### AI Ad Creative Engines
https://kilobuilds.com/services/ai-ad-creative-engines/
Turn static product photography into multi-shot, ready-to-run Meta video ads
using automated prompt engineering and benchmarked video models.

### Custom SaaS Replacements & Internal Tools
https://kilobuilds.com/services/custom-saas-replacements-internal-tools/
Replace $300 to $500/month single-purpose Shopify apps and Frankenstein
spreadsheets with private, lightweight tools hosted on the client's own
infrastructure.

### Competitor Intelligence & Content Ops
https://kilobuilds.com/services/competitor-intelligence-content-ops/
Automated Meta Ad Library tracking, storefront launch monitoring, and
structured content planning engines built around the client's creative team's
workflow.

All of the above are built as Claude Code agents wired directly into the
client's stack, not a chatbot bolted onto the front end. Audit sprints from
$150.

## Work (case studies)

Client names are withheld by request on real client engagements; the
engagement details, metrics, and numbers themselves reflect real work. Pulse
and MileFlying are public demos running on demonstration data.

### Keeping a Swedish heritage retailer in sync across three storefronts
https://kilobuilds.com/work/shopify-plus-multi-store-sync/
Tags: Multi-store sync, Translation pipeline — Production · Live
Client: Swedish Heritage DTC Brand (via Stockholm Agency Partner)
Built a custom translation and catalog publishing platform managing 1,756
products across three live Shopify Plus stores (US, Norway, and B2B).
Replaced manual copy-pasting with AI-drafted Swedish-to-English and
Swedish-to-German translations inside a side-by-side human approval editor.
- Eliminated 300+ hours of manual translation and store-to-store data entry
- One-click publishing syncs variants, images, inventory, and metafields with
  retry queues and error logs
- Strict JSON schema validation and mandatory human sign-off before any copy
  goes live

### An automated Meta video ad creative engine
https://kilobuilds.com/work/meta-video-ad-creative-engine/
Tags: Ad creative, Meta video — Production · Live
Client: Performance Marketing Agency (Stockholm)
Engineered an end-to-end creative production pipeline that converts static
product photos into multi-shot Meta video ads (wide to close-up).
Benchmarked leading video models (Seedance vs. Kling) on cost, latency, and
visual consistency before production rollout.
- Automated prompt generation via Claude turns single SKU images into
  structured multi-shot video briefs
- Standardized model routing balances generation cost against visual
  fidelity
- Built directly for media buyers to test creative variations without
  waiting weeks on external editors

### End-to-end daily YouTube news automation (n8n)
https://kilobuilds.com/work/youtube-news-automation-n8n/
Tags: n8n, Autonomous publishing — Production · Live
Stack: n8n, FFmpeg, Kokoro TTS, Python, Google Trends, VPS
Provisioned a dedicated VPS and engineered a fully autonomous daily YouTube
publishing pipeline on self-hosted n8n. Every day, the workflow pulls
trending topics from Google Trends, drafts structured news scripts,
synthesizes natural voiceovers, assembles finished video cuts
programmatically, and publishes directly to YouTube without manual editing.
- Automated daily ingestion of Google Trends data into structured,
  brand-safe video scripts
- Programmatic audio and video assembly using Kokoro TTS and FFmpeg on a
  self-hosted VPS
- Zero-touch daily YouTube upload scheduling with automated error handling
  and retries

### Competitor Watch: ad library & launch intelligence
https://kilobuilds.com/work/competitor-watch-ad-intelligence/
Tags: Competitor intel, Ad Library — Internal build · Active
Client: Internal Agency Lead-Gen Tool
Built an automated competitive intelligence tool that reads public Meta Ad
Library pages and competitor storefronts to surface long-running winning
ads, creative rebuild checklists, and newly dropped SKUs without recurring
third-party API fees.
- Zero paid API calls in default production mode
- Surfaces longest-running competitor ads with days-live tracking and
  creative breakdown checklists
- Tracks competitor storefront catalogs to flag new product launches
  automatically

### Pulse's multi-channel reporting, without the spreadsheet
https://kilobuilds.com/work/pulse/
Tags: BI dashboard, Reporting — Public Demo · Demonstration Data (not a real
named client)
Killed the manual multi-channel spreadsheet pulled together by hand from ad
platforms, Shopify, and email. Replaced it with a single dashboard that
refreshes itself, so leadership sees live numbers instead of waiting on a
report each Monday. Results shown are from demonstration data.
- Consolidated four data sources into one live report
- Removed a recurring weekly manual reporting task entirely
- Built on the client's existing stack, no new platform to learn

### MileFlying's content calendar & hook generator
https://kilobuilds.com/work/mileflying/
Tags: Competitor intel, Content planning — Public Demo · Demonstration Data
(not a real named client)
A planning tool that tracks competitor content and status across formats:
Studio, Cell Phone, Green Screen, Carousel, and generates a bank of tested
hook angles per post, so the calendar never runs dry. Results shown are from
demonstration data.
- 10-hook bank generated per content slot, ranked by pattern
- Full month view with format and upload status at a glance
- One-click status tracking from upcoming to uploaded

## FAQ

Q: Does this replace our existing tools or developers?
A: No. Every system we build works alongside what you already have. It's
wired directly into your existing stack, Shopify, your ad platforms, your
dev team's tools, not a replacement for a dev team or a rip-and-replace of
tools you already rely on.

Q: How fast do projects typically ship?
A: An Audit & Build Sprint ships the first working system inside the sprint
itself, that's the point of it. Larger, multi-system builds take longer and
get scoped per project once we know exactly what needs to be automated.

Q: Are ongoing or retainer engagements available?
A: Yes. Past the initial sprint, ongoing and retainer engagements are
available for teams who want a standing engineer on their automation
systems rather than a one-off build.

Q: What tech stacks do you support?
A: We build primarily into Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads, and n8n, with systems
hosted on Vercel and Supabase, and Claude Code as the automation engine
underneath. If your stack looks different, tell us what it is, the point is
wiring into what you already run, not migrating you to something new.

Q: What happens after the audit sprint ships?
A: You own what's built, it keeps running without us in the room. From
there, most clients either scope a second system, or move to an ongoing
retainer if there's a steady pipeline of automation work.

Q: What does the $150 audit include?
A: It is a focused, 3-to-5-day technical sprint built around one real
workflow bottleneck in your business, not a generic strategy deck. We audit
your current tools and data flow, map out the exact automation architecture
(including API requirements and recurring hosting costs), and build a
working prototype or live proof-of-concept wired directly into your stack.
At the end of the sprint, you walk away with the working prototype, a clear
system diagram, and a fixed-price build quote if you want us to take it to
full production, with your $150 credited toward the full build.

Q: Who owns the code and infrastructure after a build?
A: You own 100% of everything. We deploy all code, databases, and workflows
directly onto your own accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, n8n, or cloud VPS)
using your own API keys, and hand over full repository access and handover
documentation on completion. There is zero vendor lock-in, no proprietary
platform fee, and no ongoing markup from us. You only pay your own
lightweight hosting and API usage (typically $0 to $45/month depending on
volume), with optional monthly retainer support only if you want ongoing
feature additions.

Q: How do you sync and translate products across multiple Shopify Plus
storefronts safely?
A: Each store is connected with its own authorized access. AI-generated
translations land in an approval queue, and nothing is written to a live
store until a person signs off. Every publish is logged, so you can see what
changed, when, and in which store.
